name: print-social-outdoor-activities-mental-health-posts-navy-blue-illustration
title: 'Outdoor Activities For Mental Health' pack in navy and blue with a flat-illustrated hiker and leaf motifs
whatItIs: Five navy-to-blue gradient square posts with white-bordered cards, a flat illustration of a woman in a sun hat sitting cross-legged surrounded by giant leaf shapes and gold coins, bold headlines ('New Outdoor Event', 'Outdoor Activities for Mental Health!') and event date details.
whatItMeans: Calming and inviting; giant stylised leaves around a relaxed figure make an outdoor wellness event feel restorative.
techniques: Surround a relaxed figure with oversized nature motifs.
Frame supporting posts in a white card border.
Use a deep gradient background to set a calm mood.

vocabulary.definition: A decorative element drawn larger than realistic scale for effect.
A colour fade used to set an emotional tone.
